charlie 26.name: Charlie-26
charlie 26.origin: Charlie-26 was a Jovian who was born in Earth's colony on Jupiter in the 30th century. He and his wife lived there and had one child, a son they named Charlie-27, who was born in Galileo City in 2981 A.D. Charlie-26 and his wife were both mine workers but Charlie-26 also served in the same militia which his son would later join. In the year 3007 A.D., while Charlie-27 was away from Jupiter on six months of solitary space-militia duty, the alien Brotherhood of Badoon invaded the solar system and swiftly conquered Earth and its colonies. Although Charlie-27 lost radio contact with Jupiter two months before his tour ended, he somehow was not alarmed and did not learn about the Badoon conquest until he returned to Jupiter and was attacked soon after landing. Hoping that his folks might still be alive, Charlie-27 went to the home he shared with them and arrived just in time to see his father among a group of Jovian prisoners in a vehicle that was taking them to Eastern Zone Council Labor Camp-19. After stealing a rocket car, Charlie-27 followed the transport to the labor camp where he discovered that the prisoners were being forced to mine high-intensity Harkovite without protection, something that would cause them to die of radioactivity in five days. Charlie-27 wanted to immediately break his father out but, after subduing a single guard, he found himself faced with more Badoon than he could handle and realized that he would die for nothing if he stayed and fought. Deciding to get off Jupiter and join the rest of the United Lands of Earth forces in order to be able to liberate his people, Charlie-27 fled, hoping that he would be able to return in time to save his father. However, since the Badoon conquest had been complete and there were no U.L.E. forces to be found, there was no rescue attempt. Charlie-26 is presumed to have died in the labor camp. Years later, in 3016 A.D., Charlie-27 and his fellow Guardians of the Galaxy were on the space station Drydock whose central computer had become deranged after its entire crew had died. In order to save his friends from the insane computer's plans, Charlie-27 made his way to the central computer core where be began smashing its circuits. In an attempt to stop him, the computer used militia records to create a hologram of Charlie-26 who tried to bribe Charlie-27 by offering to give him his family back. Although this tactic caused him to experience great grief, Charlie-27 completed his mission, smashing the computer and saving his friends.
powers: Due to his Jovian ancestry, Charlie-26 is 11 times stronger and 11 times denser than a normal human being.

fields.notes: Charlie-26's name was first revealed in the entry for Charlie-27 in . That same entry identified his wife as "Mabel-15" but all subsequent handbook entries have stated that her name was "Mabel-17" instead. None of these names have ever been spoken or referenced in any published story. The first Guardians of the Galaxy story in depicted Jupiter as a planet with a solid surface where the Jovians lived and where Harkovite could be mined. However, since the real Jupiter is a gas giant with no solid surface, the story in retconned Jupiter-691 into being like its real world counterpart and established that the Jovians actually all lived in giant city-spheres that floated in Jupiter's atmosphere. Since it was thus impossible for anyone to mine Jupiter, Charlie-27's profile in later established that the Jovians actually mined the moons of Jupiter instead. A retelling of the origin of the Guardians of the Galaxy in retconned Charlie-27 into being the last living Jovian, with all other Jovians having been killed by the Badoon before he returned home. As such, Charlie-26 did not appear in that story.

charlotte christopher.name: Charlotte Christopher
charlotte christopher.origin: Priest Michael Christopher left his pregnant wife Charlotte to go on a trip to help fight for equal rights between blacks and whites. Before going, he told her to protect their unborn child, Jenny, from evil. After his flight left, however, it suddenly crashed, killing him and widowing Charlotte. Some time later, Charlotte was horrified to find that her daughter had been possessed by a demon -- although she was reluctant to believe that her daughter was truly possessed. Taking the child to her doctor, the man called in Gabriel for assistance. Upon learning that Gabriel was an exorcist she tried to throw him out, but had second thoughts when she disrupted his eye patch and saw his empty eye socket. Confronting the demon, Gabriel was forced to confront not only the demonic power, but also the monster's insight in humanity's lack of compassion when it comes to race. Gabriel defeated the demon yt getting Charlotte not only to show love towards her possessed child, but also by being able to show love to him in spite of both of them being from different ethnic backgrounds. This display of love was powerful enough to dispel the demon and free Jenny from the monster's control.

charmer.name: Charmer
charmer.origin: A member of Daredevil's circuit troupe, Charmer had the ability to create energy constructs in the shape of snakes. When the Skull's advancement across America brought an end to Daredevil's circus, Charmer and some of the other members of the circus were ordered by Captain America to travel ahead to New York and seek training under the tutelage of Scott Summers. Attacking Summers in Central Park, they convinced him to train them to be the next team of X-Men, and Charmer would fight alongside her comrades against the Skull. In the years that followed the Skull's defeat, Charmer would develop a crush on Mr. S, which would remain unrequited as he still cared for the Phoenix (who contacted him through their rapport from the Realm of the Dead and later Paradise), but she would continue to fight alongside the X-Men. When Captain America was killed aiding Mar-Vell while collecting items of power on Earth, the X-Men including Charmer joined up to help the reborn hero continue his quest. The quest took Charmer to Hel Laboratories where she met the Ant Men, the Blue Area of the Moon to witness Mar-Vell kill the Supreme Intelligence with Thor's hammer, and help battle the Wendigo in Wakanda when Mar-Vell traveled there to collect the Cosmic Cube. The X-Men would stay in Wakanda and help the nation relocate to the Savage Land in order to escape the army of Wendigo that stalked them. There, Charmer would aid her fellow X-Men, Black Panther, Storm, and the Ani-Men destroy the Wendigo army which turned out to be the mutant Multiple Man. Following this the X-Men would remain in Wakanda, and would be targeted by Belasco and the Dire Wraiths until they were saved by Mar-Vell, and Machine Man. Later, Charmer and the other X-Men attended the wedding of Medusa and King Britain.
powers: Charmer can create energy constructs in the shape of snakes.

charon olympian.name: Charon (Olympian)
charon olympian.origin: ===Ancient Times=== Charon was the son of Erebus and Nox. His duty was to ferry over the River Styx the souls of the deceased who had received the rites of burial. In payment, Charon received the coin that was placed in the mouth of the corpse. Due to his lot in life, Charon was a morose and grisly old man. During the Twelve Labors of Hercules, when he was sent to capture and take Cerberus from Hades, Hercules forced Charon to take him there. After that, Pluto punished him for letting Hercules into the Underworld by keeping him in chains for a whole year. ===Modern Era=== Doctor Strange and the X-Men found themselves in the Underworld to recover Nightcrawler's soul and believed that Margali Szardos wanted them to follow the same path as Dante and meet "Satan" himself. Opening the main gate of warning, they came to the shores of the River Acheron. They were greeted by Charon, who warned the other X-Men that if they follow Nightcrawler, they would share his fate: death. Unwilling to leave their friend behind, the X-Men and Dr. Strange agreed to accompany Charon across the River Acheron to a massive palace. Charon took Ka-Zar and his friends across the river on their journey to the Underworld. Charon took Ares to meet Pluto, in hopes of forming an alliance against Thor during a time when he was suffering from madness. Charon regularly took Hades through Tartarus to view all the tortured souls who were dammed there. Hades used this time to plot his next attack against the Asgardian Thor. Charon reluctantly took Hercules and a film crew to the Underworld. fields.history: ===Ancient Times=== Charon was the son of Erebus and Nox. His duty was to ferry over the River Styx the souls of the deceased who had received the rites of burial. chase.species: Human, son of two mad scientists
chase.origin: ===Origin=== The accidental conception of Chase Stein was the event that led his parents and the other members of the Pride to decide to pass on their inheritance from the Gibborim to their children. Chase's parents, Victor and Janet Stein made a fortune from inventing a tool that allowed opening up new CDs "without ripping [any] fingernails off", but as scientists/engineers they actually created weapons, tech, and transport for The Pride. thumb|left|Victor Stein (Earth-616)|Victor beating his son, Chase Against his parents' hopes, Chase was very athletic and did not share their aptitude for science. Chase was regularly beaten by his father for receiving poor grades, focusing too much on sports, and often even without any explanation at all. During Chase's childhood, a business associate in the Los Angeles crime scene, "Creepy Uncle Eli", often visited. When his parents finally cut off ties with him, Eli came into Chase's room as a threat to his parents. For his sixteenth birthday, Chase asked for a plain white van because he wanted anonymity and the secret desire to just disappear one day. Around this time, Chase discovered The Hostel after reading about a "missing mansion" in one of his father's books. Chase began spending time at this location because it was "off the beaten track". He later purchased a sign warning of a lethal radiation testing site to prevent others from exploring his haunt. Not long after receiving his van, Chase accidentally ran over his Uncle Hunter after Hunter had an argument with his parents. Chase believed Hunter died that night and had gotten taken care of by his parents, but he somehow survived. ===Runaways=== Along with Alex Wilder, Nico Minoru, and Gertrude Yorkes, Chase witnessed his parents and the Pride sacrifice Destiny Gonzales for the Ritual of Blood. thumb|left|Chase discovering the Fistigons While searching for evidence, Chase commandeered some of the weapons from his father's workshop including the Fistigons and X-Ray Specs. After rescuing Molly and narrowly escaping their parents, Chase suggested the group take refuge in The Hostel. Chase received the codename "Talkback" from Gert's sarcastic remark about his habit of talking back. Chase's insecurity and stubbornness often put him at odds with the other Runaways, but particularly with Gert. As the only Runaway with a driver's license, Chase transported the team in his unmarked white van. thumb|right|Chase and Gert's first kiss After infiltrating the Marine Vivarium to confront the Pride, Chase nearly drown trying to protect his friends from the defensive security golem. It was Arsenic who administered CPR and saved his life. This led to the pairs first kiss and the culmination of their romantic tension. Still weak from his near-death, Chase passed on his Fistigons and X-Ray Specs to Alex Wilder. After Alex's betrayal and death, Chase, piloting the Leapfrog, was able to rescue the other Runaways and escape in the before the Gibborim destroyed the Marine Vivarium killing all the members of the Pride. After narrowly escaping the destruction of the Marine Vivarium, the Runaways were immediately apprehended by Captain America and placed into foster care. Chase told the authorities that he was going live with an aunt in Anaheim, but provide the P.O.Box address he used to receive pornographic magazines. Chase had completely disappeared until weeks later after a text message from Karolina when he and the other Runaways reconvened at the Griffith Observatory. Together they decided to retrieve Old Lace and the Leapfrog, and run away again. The Runaways eventually located one of the Pride's old lairs beneath the La Brea Tar Pits, and took up residence there. They also began defending Los Angeles from all of the villains trying to fill the power vacuum left by the absence of the Pride. With the Fistigons destroyed, Chase's primary responsibility in the group became piloting the Leapfrog. ===Gertrude=== thumb|right|Chase and Gert love each other After an unsuccessful mission to rescue Excavator from his father and the Wrecking Crew, the team returned to the Hostel to be comforted by a mortally wounded Heroine, a woman claiming to Gert's future self and leader of the Avengers. Using the 4-D Time Portico, she narrowly escaped the onslaught of Victorious, with a message to the Runaways: find Victor Mancha and stop him from becoming this deadly super-villain. Heroine then died in Chase's arms. thumb|right|Chase jealous of Victor Although Gert and Chase's relationship was proceeding, Gert friendliness with Victor Mancha led to feelings of insecurity in Chase. Long after the other Runaways had accepted Victor, Chase continued to distrust him. During a trip to New York City to help Cloak, Chase and Nico went searching for a drug dealer in Washington Square Park. During their confrontation with Pusher Man, a bluff from Chase about working for the Pride, save his and Nico's lives resulting in a brief kiss much to Chase's protest. In thei

fields.notes: Chase was 17 years old during his initial appears in . Chase's 18th birthday occurred in . Chase often comes across as being a dumb obnoxious jock, but he is surprisingly street smart and devoted to his friends. Terry Romita has stated that Chase could have a future as the next-gen Captain America.
fields.trivia: In Brian K. Vaughan's original pitch for the series, Chase was named John and the sibling-like relationship Chase shares with Molly was between Gert and Molly. right|thumb|Chase asking about weed It has been hinted multiple times that Chase uses cannabis. Chase appears to be Christian. When first attacked by Old Lace, he recites The Lord's Prayer, and he later refers to the Devil as a real being. He also called Karolina an angel after her alien powers were activated but before her origins were revealed. Before learning that his parents were members of The Pride, Chase wanted to be an announcer for , but after his experiences with the Runaways he decided that he wanted to join the F.B.I. to help other troubled teens like themselves with the added perk of carrying a gun all the time. It is implied that Chase lost his virginity to Gertrude. Chase mentioned that he was a virgin in . Later it is revealed that he and Gert shared a bed and a few innuendoes were made about their sexual relationship. Gert actually died in Chase's arms twice: Once as an adult as Heroine and once as her adolescent self. Chase apparently had terrible handwriting. right|thumb|Gertrude Yorkes (Earth-616)|Gert seeing Chase's tattoo Chase has a tattoo on his lower left abdomen of a heart with Gert's name inside.

che.name: Che
che.origin: The mercenary known as Che trained at the Shaolin Monastery where the monks who helped him learn to summon his chi strength. When the monks were killed by Mys-Tech, Che decided to investigate. He infiltrated the organization by becoming one of their Warheads, quickly becoming leader of Malkuth Troop, and one of the best Warheads. During a Warheads mission, Malkuth Troop encountered Cable and most of the team was killed. Che was captured and Cable discovered that Che also wanted to bring about the end of Mys-Tech. Che agreed to spy on Mys-Tech for Cable. With the destruction of his team, Che was transferred to Kether Troop. Che remained active with the Warheads for a number of missions, surviving 50 missions to other worlds and becoming a trainer for recruits. His loyalty to Mys-Tech was under question and he was being sent on increasingly dangerous missions. However, he was eventually killed by Mys-Tech guards; only to have his body stolen by Cable and then resurrected by Vorin to become a Shadow Rider in a new, mutated form. Che, possibly due to his immunity to magic, eventually reverted to human form. He then joined Colonel Liger's reformed Kether Troop who sought to help destroy Mys-Tech. During a transdimensional mission to Hell, the Troop was trapped there to ensure Mys-Tech failed. Liger had offered to save the Troop but was saved by members of the team. Back on earth, Liger recruited Agent Keller to help him rescue his team.

cheer chadwick.name: Cheer Chadwick
cheer chadwick.origin: A privileged and somewhat spoiled debutante, Cheer Chadwick was a member of the Elite, a group of royalists who plotted to overthrow the United States. She was fascinated when her Royalist Forces captured Captain America and his partner the Falcon. She ordered the two freed to participate in an Elite sponsored Kill-Derby. Captain America won the event, but angered Cheer Chadwick when he refused to kill his opponents as was customary. Chadwick was further incensed when the two heroes, along with the US Army, overran the Elite facility in the western Badlands. Cheer escaped with her father in an underground pneumatic car. Cheer Chadwick has apparently continued her association with the Elite and was more recently affiliated with the Secret Empire as well as the Sons of the Serpent.

cheiros.name: Cheiros
cheiros.origin: ===Life=== Cheiros was a bat-winged Inhuman, and a leader among the Winged Ones. Kylus eventually managed to have King Nestor built Aerie, a city held by anti-gravitic engine, for the Winged Inhumans to be free of flying there. Hostiliy kept growing nonetheless between the wingless Inhumans and the Winged Ones, until Kylus declared secession and war upon Attilan. Cheiros was of the few to oppose Kylus, and was immediately arrested. Kylus then decided to purge the "weakness" from Aerie, including Cheiros, the bat-winged and all other non-white-feathered winged Inhumans, and had them all slaughtered within hours. Cheiros was martyred, Kylus trying in vain to make him admit complicity with the "groundlings". ===Legacy=== The genocide of all non-white-feathered Bird People, including Cheiros' martyr, became a shame to later Bird People. The Cheiros Hill of the Aerie were named in his honor. The Red Raven was also gifted with artificial bat-like wings in his honor, Aerivar the 18th intending to make of him the "Heir of Cheiros".

Hostiliy kept growing nonetheless between the wingless Inhumans and the Winged Ones, until Kylus declared secession and war upon Attilan. Cheiros was of the few to oppose Kylus, and was immediately arrested. Kylus then decided to purge the "weakness" from Aerie, including Cheiros, the bat-winged and all other non-white-feathered winged Inhumans, and had them all slaughtered within hours. Cheiros was martyred, Kylus trying in vain to make him admit complicity with the "groundlings". ===Legacy=== The genocide of all non-white-feathered Bird People, including Cheiros' martyr, became a shame to later Bird People. The Cheiros Hill of the Aerie were named in his honor. The Red Raven was also gifted with artificial bat-like wings in his honor, Aerivar the 18th intending to make of him the "Heir of Cheiros".

chen hsu.name: Chen Hsu
chen hsu.origin: Chen Hsu is the leader of a group of aliens from the planet Kakaranthara, fourth planet of the Maklu System, that traveled to Earth to look for the conflict which was unknown in their culture, and which they craved. The ship crashed, stranding them on Earth. Many thousands of years later, the Mandarin found their ship and claimed their rings. Years later, the Mandarin travelled to San Francisco's Chinatown to find Chen Hsu, who was responsible for stealing one of the Mandarin's rings and replacing it with a duplicate. Chen Hsu politely returned the true ring to him. Once the Mandarin slipped it on he doubled over in pain and fell to the floor. Chen Hsu now used his own mystic knowledge to remove the shadows that have clouded the Mandarin's memory. The Mandarin returned to Valley of the Sleeping Dragon where he came upon a huge ancient doorway, built inside of a mountain. It was in the temple he found the ancient dragon Fin Fang Foom. Mandarin has awoke the dragon and offered to enter into a covenant with him in an effort to re-mold the world. Fin Fang Foom emerges and completely razes the entire region, but the Mandarin and Chen Hsu control the dragon, which allowed them to take over one-third of China. The Mandarin sent a message to the Chinese government declaring that he expected them to yield total and complete control over the entire country over to him. Failure to do so would incur the wrath of the Mandarin and Fin Fang Foom. Meanwhile, Chen Hsu trained the Mandarin to improve him. When Iron Man confronted the Mandarin and Fin Fang Foom he was easily defeated by the dragon. During the battle eight other dragons appeared, and Chen Hsu revealed that he was also a dragon. The dragons revealed their origin and plans, and demand the rings back, but the Mandarin refused them. Iron Man forcibly combined his power with the rings, and managed to destroy the Makluan dragons.

chen zhao.name: Chen Zhao
chen zhao.origin: The wife of Lim Zhao and figurehead of his billionaire corporate assets, Mrs. Zhao was an adamant mutant hater. Her discontent with Mutants (Homo superior) bloomed into anti-mutant activism once her husband became an Order of X advocate after the worldwide message broadcast by X establishing Krakoa as a nation. Rather disquieted by the turn of events, Chen incarcerated her husband within their own home, aiming to use his fabricated disappearance as a means of garnering support for her anti-mutant smear campaign; both to discredit the mutant race and further her own profits through racism and subterfuge. thumb|200px|left|Giving a speech When she rebuked Bishop's inquiries into the whereabouts of her husband, he opted to work with Kate Pryde to find the truth on their own. While at a hate rally she was sponsoring, Chen was dismayed to find the two mutants had rescued and brought her husband to her, looking no worse for wear. After a brief scorning by Kathrine about mutants no longer being viable for scapegoating, Zhao was left publicly humiliated in front of her support group now that her scheme had been revealed. Seeking restitution, she aligned herself with the new anti-mutant government established in Madripoor, where the inner circle of Homines Verendi inducted her into their sect as the White Bishop. At the service of her new nation, she went on a "diplomatic mission" to attack the Marauder, but Kate Pryde, the captain of the ship being attacked, didn't care for her diplomatic immunity and threw her off-board after punching her in the face.

cheryl gates.name: Cheryl Gates
cheryl gates.origin: Raving Beauty started as a runner-up in a Ms. U.S.A. pageant She attempted to become a famous actress and found the producer Mr. Redmond, who put her in horror movies and adult movies. While starring in the adult movies, she began to do drugs supplied by Mr. Redmond and his crew to help get through them, but this ultimatly made her less desirable as an actress and Mr. Redmond helped her become a prostitute before he discarded her. Some time later, after seemingly recovered, she began seeking revenge against Mr. Remond's crew. She killed Andros in Los Angeles and Gil Tremaine in Las Vegas using poisoned lipstick. These exploits were reported by Mike Lourdes of the Hollywood Examiner. She traveled to San Francisco where she was ambushed by two goons sent by Mr. Redmond, she took one down while the Punisher took down the other. SHe revealed her history to him and the two teamed up to take down Mr. Redmond. They approached his compound and witnessed a helicopter getting shot down. They found the helicopter belonged to Lourdes and armed it with grenades to explode. Raving Beauty and the Punisher took out Redmond's men that came to find them and others were killed when the helicopter exploded. The pair broke into Redmond' compound and took out the rest of his men, leaving only Redmond alive, allowing Raving Beauty to kill him. To hide her identity, Lourdes reported that she had died in the helicopter explosion. Her wherabouts and activities are currently unknown but Iron Man considered her as a recruit for the 50-State Initiative.

cheryl porter.name: Cheryl Porter
cheryl porter.origin: For a long time, Cheryl Porter lived and worked overseas, where she met her husband Geoff. During their honeymoon, she discovered they were aboard a smuggling ship to bring the Titanium Man in the United States. Fearing for Geoff's life, she alerted Tony Stark with an anonymous call, but she was spotted and soon pursued by the The Mercenary, so she snuck into Stark's car to get his help. Stark agreed and took her to his lodge in the Adirondack Mountains. Intending to trick Cheryl into letting him into the lodge's bunker, the Mercenary disguised himself as Stark, only to be mistakenly slain by Vincent Sandhurst, who died in turn seconds later. Cheryl was eventually rescued by the real Tony Stark and brought back to New York City.

chester fenton.origin: Chester Fenton was a taxi driver working close to the NASA base where Mar-Vell was working under his guise as Dr. Walter Lawson. Fenton often drove Mar-Vell to the base, but most of those times, those trips were cut short when Mar-Vell would have to change into his identity as Captain Marvel. As a result, Fenton would always remember Mar-Vell/Lawson as the passenger who preferred to walk the rest of the distance.

chester freeman.name: Chester Freeman
chester freeman.origin: Much of Pinball's history remains unknown, but he was an enemy of Nighthawk, and an experienced professional costumed criminal. He was a good friend of his fellow criminal Remnant, and often worked in tandem with him. When their Earth's premier superhero team the Squadron Supreme instigated their "Utopia Program" that included behavior-modifying criminals, a worried Pinball and Remnant joined forces with the villainess Mink. They approached their Earth's Sorcerer Supreme, Professor Imam for help. Imam agreed to transport the three criminals to an alternate Earth, Earth-616. Once there, they began a crime spree, and clashed with Captain America and Nighthawk, who had come to that Earth seeking allies to join him in opposing the Squadron's Program. Although the Captain couldn't help, he encouraged Nighthawk to join forces with the three criminals. They returned to their own Earth, and formed the core of the Redeemers. Pinball was with the Redeemers when they confronted the Squadron, and the confrontation soon turned to combat. Pinball was taken out of the battle early on when he was knocked out by the Whizzer, and was left to roll aimlessly around the battlefield. Pinball was killed when Blue Eagle, whose wings had been depowered, attempted to land on his inflatable suit. The collision punctured Pinball's lungs, and he died, much to his friend Remnant's dismay.

chester harrigan.name: Chester Harrigan
chester harrigan.origin: A Stark Enterprises employee who desperately wanted the job as Iron Man, Chester routinely turned in an application in hopes of being selected to wear the suit. Eventually getting the opportunity to chauffeur Tony Stark around, he attempted to get Stark to listen to his request, only to be brushed off and then attacked by armored criminal Skullcrasher. Surviving the battle, but seeing how dangerous a job Iron Man had, he instead began seeking a job as a security guard, hoping to learn something about dealing with criminals before once again trying to renew his dream of being Iron Man.

chester musgrave.name: Chester Musgrave
chester musgrave.origin: General Chester Musgrave was kidnapped by the Scorpion during a peace award ceremony in Brooklyn. Spider-Man intervened, but, when the Scorpion heard attending photographer Lance Bannon mention J. Jonah Jameson, he instead demanded Jameson be turned over to him in exchange for Gen. Musgrave. The Scorpion held him hostage in Brooklyn for a while, then hijacked a chopper and escaped, hiding into an abandoned farm in Connecticut. Gen. Musgrave was moved again to New York City when the Scorpion decided to bring him to the Kingpin. However, the villain got lost driving into the city, and wound up in Queens, where Spidey finally caught him. As Justin Hammer's agents Rhino and Blacklash appeared at the old World's Fair grounds chasing the Scorpion, they left Musgrave behind and the General was eventually rescued by Spider-Man.

chester orsen.name: Chester Orsen
chester orsen.origin: Chester Orsen was the general manager of National Aero Company, a plane manufacturer that had test pilot and inventor Don Gorman in its employ. When Gorman invented a new jet engine that could allow planes to fly at 1000 miles an hour, Orsen attempted to convince Gorman to sell it to Nazi purchasing agent Anson Dictor. Gorman refused, intending to turn the plans over to the US government once he had completed his testing. Later, when Gorman needed to test the engines long range flight capabilities, Orsen used his connections with All-State Airlines to install the engines into their commercial airliner fleet. Orsen and Dictor then had all the planes redirected to a secret Nazi base on American soil during the flight, causing nationwide panic over the missing passengers. When Gorman was hired to track down the planes Orsen and Dictor hired men to try and eliminate him. They failed, and Gorman led the US Air Force to the location of the stolen planes. Exposing Orsen and Dictor as the plane thieves, they were both arrested.

chetfield murray.name: Chetfield Murray
chetfield murray.origin: A mutant discovered by Cerebro, Chet Murray had the power to suppress the mutant powers of others. Wolverine hired him once a year to take him out drinking, letting Chet suppress his healing factor enough for Logan to get really drunk. Chet earned a degree in visual arts from an art school. However, he was coasting at an easy job he hated, occasionally getting to design fliers and résumés. His mother hectored him that his degree was a waste of time. After one of his annual outings with Wolverine ended with Logan on fire following a bar fight, Chet put him in a cab and sent him back to the X-Mansion. His experience with Wolverine motivated Chet to quit his job.
powers: projects a dampening field from his body that disables the mutant abilities of anyone within 10 feet of him.
abilities: Graphic Designer

chi chan.name: Chi Chan
chi chan.origin: Chi Chan was one of the Dragon Lords, a crew member of the Makluan starship that crashed in ancient China. She like here fellow Makluans learned to survive on Earth over the following three millennia, assuming human form and adapting to human ways. Upon receiving a telepathic call from their leader Chen Hsu, like her fellow Makluans, she reverted back to her dragon form and flew back to the Valley of the Sleeping Dragon. Where she joined the rest of the Dragon Lords, and along with most of them changed to a human form to meet the Mandarin. To convince him to willingly turn over the ten rings and serve them, Chi Chan informed him that he would see wonders and experience infinite pleasures in service to the Dragon Lords. Chen Hsu her captain advised the Mandarin that she was most skilled in such. Mandarin's defiance resulted in battle which was soon joined by Iron Man, both fighting to keep the rings from the Dragon Lords. The battle ended in the defeat of the Dragon Lords, when Iron Man supercharged the Mandarin's rings, creating a nuclear-level explosion.

chi lo.name: Chi Lo
chi lo.origin: While awaiting the next visit of the Celestials to Earth, the deities of the planet decided to find a way to convince the visitors that humankind was worthy of survival. Over the span of ten centuries, these deities selected twelve ordinary men and women as a sample of humanity. Each of the chosen had mastered one of humanity's greatest fields of achievement. Each of these humans was endowed with godlike powers. Chi Lo was a Japanese woman, originating from a small seacoast village. She was reportedly well-educated, but chose the life of a farmer for herself. She mastered the skills of her chosen field. She lacked in assertiveness, but made up for it in determination. Once Chi Lo set a goal for herself, no obstacle could prevent her from achieving it. When she was 19-years-old, in the early 1970s, Chi Lo was chosen by the deities as a member of their sample of humanity.

chiantang.name: Chiantang
chiantang.first_appearance: Power Man and Iron Fist Vol 1 118
chiantang.origin: thumb|left|250px|Martial artist form The impulsive Chiantang is the brother of the Dragon King. He is in fact a 100 ft deadly flying dragon. However, he often disguises himself as a mortal. He also has the ability to cast potent spells. An enraged Chiantang, transformed to his true dragon form, and ravaged and killed many citizens of K'un-Lun. He ruled the city for some time with terror and death. He has been defeated, captured, and exiled on different occasions by the power of the mystic sword Dragonslayer. Chiantang originally sought vengeance on K'un-Lun when a mortal seduced and debased his sister. Chiantang mystically transformed the offending mortal into an "Undying One" seemingly immortal dragon, chained him, and had his heart torn out and placed in a cauldron. Iron Fist challenged this dragon, slew him, and stole the "Heart of the Dragon" which became a part of his essence, his immortal Iron Fist. This act further enraged Chiantang, and he swore vengeance on Iron Fist for releasing this mortal from his undying, eternal torture. Using the power of "Dragonslayer" Chiantang was defeated and banished. However, his banishment was to New York City. He quickly plotted his revenge on Cage and Daniel Rand. Unfortunately for him, he was killed by Master Khan and Colleen Wing. Khan (disguised as Tyrone King) shot Chiantang in the head while he was still in his human form. Wing decapitated Chiantang with her sword. Black Dragon was later resurrected by Nightshade, who laced his genetic code with a specialized bomb in an attempt to manipulate him into doing her bidding. Refusing to serve as Nightshade's puppet, Chiantang laid clusters of eggs underwater to create a baseline of genetic material. While waiting for the eggs to mature, he called in the favors of several gods, and stole the body of Everett K. Ross, trapping Ross in a body resembling Mephisto in an attempt to misdirect Black Panther from his trail. After Black Panther learned what happened to his friend, the Wakandan king attempted to negotiate with Chiantang- and when the Black Dragon refused to return Ross' body, he destroyed Chiantang's egg clusters with high tech depth charges in retribution. Unable to confront King T'Challa in Ross' mortal body, and unable to return to his dragon form without Nightshade's genetic bomb's antidote in his possession Chiantang was forced to find a different means of confronting the Panther. Using more divine favors, he returned Iron Fist's powers, after Junzo had previously stolen them, and used hypnotic influence to bind Danny to his service in repayment, making his former enemy the Black Dragon's Champion. Under Chiantang's orders, Rand ambushed Black Panther outside of his underwater vessel and engaged in a brutal fist fight, stretching across the streets of New York, and resulting in T'Challa taking so savage a beating that it resulted in near-fatal aneurysm. Ultimately, T'Challa was able to reverse the work Chiantang had done to Rand's chi and release him from the Dragon's service- but while the Wakandan king was distracted, Chinatang was able to regain his true form, and emerged from the ocean intending to finish the job personally. He rampaged through the city in his dragon form, ignoring attacks from T'Challa's vibranium weaponry, Iron Fist's chi, and air strikes from both Wakandan ships and the US Air Force. Further enraged by the heroes' attempts to negotiate a peace with him, Chiantang decided to spend his final moments before the genetic bomb ended his life destroying Wakanda. Ultimately, T'Challa was able to rig up some bio-implants based on scans of Chiantang's dragon form to force his transformation back into his human self- stabilizing his condition but trapping him in the guise of a mortal human, and taking him prisoner.
weaknesses: Reportedly, the sword Dragonslayer can -- as the name implies -- kill him, but Chiantang has disputed this claim.

He came into contact with the team again, when looking for his daughter, and during that time, he revealed some deep knowledge about Tokens, which helped the team recover his daughter and 2 missing students.

chief sitting duck.name: Chief Sitting Duck
chief sitting duck.first_appearance: Peter Porker, The Spectacular Spider-Ham Vol 1 3
chief sitting duck.origin: Chief Sitting Duck was one of the only two surviving members of the Duckowee Native American tribe, along with warrior One-Feather. As of the 1840s, they found a small town, Pleasantville, where they wanted to settle - but, before they could do so, Pleasantville was evacuated because the locals moved to California looking for gold. Sitting Duck performed spells so that time would not pass there and that noone could find them, giving rise to the legend of Shang-Goo-La. The spell failed during the 1950s and the town was assaulted by a band of barbarian bikers, the Sickle Club, who imprisoned the Duckowees. It took them 30 years to dig a escape tunnel; when they did, One-Feather was sent with a map to find help. Unfortunately, One-Feather's use of magic was imperfect and he turned into a baby, then an egg. Fortunately, One-Feather's map ended up in newspaper editor J. Jonah Jackal, who decided to go after the story with several journalists, including Bunsen Bunny, J. Jeremiah Jackal, Upton Adam Stray and photographer Peter Porker (the later being secretly superhero Spider-Ham). The bikers imprisoned all of them and tried to lynch them, but Spider-Ham used his powers to rescue them and, following Sitting Duck's plan, goaded the bikers to leave the town. Once they were outside the town, they turned into elderly people with no way to come back to the town, and even their bikes broke. Unfortunately, the journalist were also unable to prove the existance of Shang-Goo-La, and Sitting Duck never knew what happened to his last brave one, One-Feather.

chiga.name: Chiga
chiga.origin: Chiga was a witch doctor who lived among a unspecified tribe in the the Republic of the Congo during the 1950s. By 1955, seeking to gain dominance over the region, he used ancient magics to create typhoons which swept away the local warriors as well as hunter Greg Knight, depositing them on a far off plateau. Seeing Lorna the Jungle Girl as a greater threat, Chiga used his magics to dump Lorna in the deadly Grey Swamp where she had to fend off large reptilian creatures and man-eating plants. She ultimately found her way to the plateau where the others were being kept prisoner by hitching a ride on a massive vulture. There Chiga appeared to gloat over his victory but was shocked to see that Lorna had survived. Lorna leaped into his typhoon and battled him until the badly frightened mystic surrender to her superior strength and surrendered. Chiga was turned over to his tribe for punishment, his subsequent fate is unknown.
abilities: Some knowledge in magic

chin hsi.name: Chin Hsi
chin hsi.origin: Chin Hsi served as the protector of a Taoist monastery in his youth, during which time he could transform into the "Foe-Dog", a mystically-empowered being that resembled a Chinese guardian lion. He would seemingly lose his connection to the Foe-Dog in the 1930s, when the monastery linked to it was disbanded. Nevertheless, Chin Hsi would continue to look after his home, even as it transformed into a shantytown. As an old man, Chin Hsi would encounter the X-Man Iceman, whose powers had been sent out of control by artificially-created warriors known as the Augmen. While Bobby was unconscious, his powers surrounded him and attacked the surrounding town, causing Foe-Dog to reawaken from within Chin Hsi once more. After subduing Bobby's powers, Chin Hsi took him back to his home, thanking him for helping him find his purpose again.

chin mae.name: Chin-Mae
chin mae.origin: Chin-Mae was a Korean fisherman who took Logan in after he narrowly escaped death following a fight with pirates in Madripoor. Hosted by him and his wife, Logan spent one of the best times of his life, immersed in the tranquility of the life of a humble fisherman. When Chul-Moo forcibly intervened to get Chin-Mae to sell his land to build hotels, Logan came to his defense, but later, Chin-Mae's aide Duck-Hwan betrayed him and as a result Chul-Moo had Chin-Mae and his wife killed and appropriated his land.

chip ladby.name: Chip Ladby
chip ladby.origin: Chip Ladby was a man adopted by the Ladby family. Chip was in love with Louise Wharton, but she only had eyes for Stephen Dowell, a track champion; this made Chip jealous. During a background check at Dr. Bryan Hoskins' office, Chip discovered, while looking through the doctor's files, the document related to Hoskins' experiment regarding raising a Martian child to become a perfect Earthling, and became convinced that the Martian was his rival in love, Stephen Dowell. Convinced that he could use the document to reveal Stephen's true nature, Dr. Hoskins asked him if he was sure that the Martian was Stephen since he himself was adopted. Scared by this, for fear that they would discover that he was an alien, Chip left town. Days later, Dr. Hoskins attended Stephen and Louise's wedding, and thought to himself about what Chip had discovered, but that in reality the Martian was Louise.

chipp.name: Chipp
chipp.origin: Chipp was a Sparkitect hired by Mojo to use the power of the Sparkitendrils to spice up the mundane life of Howard the Duck, who was the unwitting protagonist of his own reality show, which was secretly filmed by Mojo and broadcast across the galaxy. However, Mojo started blackmailing Chipp and his partner Jho, threatening to reveal what they had been doing to their superiors. In order to get Mojo off their backs, Chipp and Jho decided to influence Howard's life into sending him right to Mojo to dismantle his operation. The plan appeared to have worked until Chipp and Jho realized Mojo was eventually going to find out they were trying to betray him. The two Sparkitects flew to the Earth in an attempt to intercept Mojo before he could retaliate against them. When they arrived to the scene of Mojo's fight against Howard the Duck, Chipp tried to defuse the situation and convince Mojo to calm down in exchange of trying to talk their bosses into agreeing to make Mojo the protagonist of the next big crossover, but Mojo refused. The Iron Punisher joined the brawl, having being part of a backup plan put in motion back in Sparkitron in case Mojo didn't give in. The distraction caused by this turn of events gave Chipp the opportunity to run back to his ship, but Howard tackled him, fueled by rage for having being victim of the Sparkitects' manipulation. Chipp held Howard at knifepoint, and tried to use him as leverage to escape from Mojo to another universe. When Chipp was distracted by the sudden absence of Jho and their ship, Howard broke free from his grasp and started to beat him up. Chipp managed to reach his knife and stabbed Howard in the stomach. Chipp stole from Howard a spheric calling card given by Scout, and imbued himself with its Power Cosmic, with the intention to use it to escape to the far reaches of the cosmos. Howard was brought back to life by Doctor Strange, and took advantage of the sphere's ability to summon Scout, who absorbed the Power Cosmic from Chipp. Powerless, Chipp was easily knocked out by Howard and later arrested by his superiors.

chips brant.name: Chips Brant
chips brant.origin: Chips Brant was a notorious gambler who, in 1941, would frame John Scott for a murder he did not commit. When John would be sentenced to death, his son Larry would learn the truth and confront Brant to try and force him to confess. Instead, Brant's men would knock Larry out and bind him until his father would be executed. Larry would break free and manage to get evidence that would prove his fathers innocence however would arrive to late to stop the execution. Brant and his men would decide to leave town, however before they could they would be attacked by Father Time (Larry in a costumed identity) who would easily beat them into submission and leave them for the authorities to apprehend. Brants fate is unrevealed, but it's likely that he may have been executed for his crimes.

chiquita tarantula.name: Chiquita Tarantula
chiquita tarantula.origin: Chiquita Tarantula was the girlfriend of "Big Time" Barnelle, a notorious bank robber who was active in the 1940s. When Barnelle was incarcerated in 1945, he and Chiquita corresponded back and forth, using coded messages that Barnelle would swallow after reading. Barnelle soon began planning to break out so that he could reclaim some stolen loot he had hiding out and began plotting with Chiquita. He was unaware that Chiquita intended to murder him and claim the money for herself. In order to maintain her innocence, she tracked down the Angel to help "dissuade" her boyfriend from breaking out of prison. On the day of the jailbreak, she sent Barnelle another coded letter, this one coated with deadly spider venom. After the Angel interviewed Barnelle, he succumbed to the poison. After the jail break was thwarted, the Angel found that Barnelle was not among the dead prisoners gunned down by the guards, but dead in his room from poison. Going back to Chiquita's apartment, the Angel fed her a false story about how Barnelle managed to escape but died, noting the imprints on her blotter of the last letter she wrote to Barnelle. Staking out her apartment, the Angel witnessed Chiquita meet with some of Barnelle's men who had the location of his hidden loot. Learning the location she then pulled a gun on them. When the Angel crashed into the room, Chiquita tossed poisonous spiders on Barnelle's gang members and attempted to flee the scene. The Angel stopped her and after preventing her from swallowing a poisoned pill, she was turned her over to the authorities.
weapons: Chiquita was armed with a pistol, she also used poisonous spiders, and extracted their venom to poison her victims as well.

chiroptera.name: Chiroptera
chiroptera.origin: Chiroptera was a winged semi-humanoid who resembled a man-sized bat and was from an unspecified alien world. At some point, Chiroptera was chosen to be one of six pawns that would be used by the Prime Mover in his contest with the Grandmaster. During the first round of the game, Chiroptera was paired with the winged horse-like Takkor and they were both transported to an alien world where jagged spires of stone jutted up through purple mists toward a fiery orange sky. Finding themselves facing the Valkyrie (astride her winged horse Aragorn) and Nighthawk, Chiroptera struck first, diving down at Nighthawk, hurling him into the swirling mists below and pursuing him into those mists. Once they were both enshrouded by the mists, Chiroptera's sonar ability made it possible for him to attack Nighthawk while the Earth hero's vision was impaired by the mists, thus preventing him from fighting back effectively. Chiroptera began to tear Nighthawk apart and soon ripped off his wings, prompting Nighthawk to fly up and out of the mists as soon a he could manage it. Certain that Chiroptera had somehow been able to see while down in the mists, Nighthawk noticed that Chiroptera's constant screeching was "making more noise than a cave full of bats," prompting him to realize that those noises may have been how the alien saw, like an Earth bat's "sonar." Suspecting that that might mean that Chiroptera was "as blind as a real bat," Nighthawk spotted a nearby stone arch and baited Chiroptera into closely following him. Although Nighthawk managed to fly through the narrow arch, Chiroptera wasn't able to detect the arch in time and he flew right into the stone. Either killed by the impact or knocked unconscious, Chiroptera fell from the sky, with Nighthawk believing that, if he was still alive, then he would die when he hit bottom. With the Valkyrie having already defeated her opponent, the Grandmaster's pawns won the first round.
weaknesses: Chiroptera's sense of sight was not very good, forcing him to rely on his sonar sense.

fields.notes: This character was only referred to as "that bat thing" in , and was one of three new characters introduced in that comic who weren't given names. Unlike Dumog and Teju, who were both named less than three years later when they next appeared in , this character wasn't named until "Chiroptera" was listed as one of the pawns of the Prime Mover in that character's profile in . He was also mentioned (as "the batlike Chiroptera") in a profile of the Prime Mover that appeared in . However, that name has so far not received any in-story confirmation. That OHOTMU A-Z HC#9 profile also claimed that the Prime Mover's pawns were "all natives of Reality-691" but that hasn't been confirmed in any story either. It is a remarkable coincidence that the name of this character with some batlike characteristics is also the name of the order (taxonomic rank) which comprises all of the flying mammals commonly called "bats." While Chiroptera does have some batlike features, his biggest dissimilarity to bats, aside from his size, is the fact that he has arms as well as wings, unlike bats, whose wings are their forelimbs. In two close-up views of Chiroptera's face, his eyes can clearly be seen to have irises but no pupils. However, his eyeballs, which are white in the first image, are red in the second image. Although this article's main image shows Chiroptera with red eyes, in the original printing of that story that panel showed his eyes as being the same purple color as the rest of his face. Presumably the red color was added when the story was reprinted.

chleee.name: Chleee
chleee.origin: Chleee was a member of the Glx species who was mortally wounded in a crash landing. He came upon escaped convicts Johnny Anvil and "Hammer" Jackson, who had been chained together prior. Chleee asked for them to aid him, but Hammer shot him multiple times in the chest using a gun that he stole during his escape. Because Chleee's body is made of a silicant, the bullets were absorbed into his body and saved him. Not knowing that Hammer's intent was to kill him, Chleee destroyed the original chain that had been holding the two together and replaced it with a gold colored one that gave the two incredible strength before he departed.

chloe tran.name: Chloe Tran
chloe tran.origin: Chloe Tran was hired by Marc Spector as a cook and housekeeper after he returned from Los Angeles and moved back into his Long Island residence of Spector Mansion. She was aware of his identity as Moon Knight and associated with Jean-Paul DuChamp, his pilot nicknamed "Frenchie". Chloe helped provide physical therapy to Jean-Paul after he was injured in a crash, and the two of them began a relationship following that. However, Chloe was also secretly an acolyte of the Knights Templar, an ancient order dedicated to protecting the true historical record of the world. When one of their own members, Seth the Immortal, turned on the Templar, Chloe became a fugitive, and avoided Seth and the Hellbent he had turned to his side. She arrived on Fifth Avenue and recognized the Cadre as Hellbent, to rescue them from Code: Blue and calm down Dementia. Chloe then accompanied the Hellbent trio back to their former home where they found the corpses of Gregori and the rest of the monks stationed there. Chloe took the Hellbent trio to an apartment room behind an abandoned facade and false walls in a seemingly dead tenement just south of the Manhattan riverfront's Alphabet City, her own privately-secured sanctuary, purchased via the Templar's "black account" set up shortly after her initiation and known only to her.

chlreee.name: Chlreee
chlreee.origin: Prime Theoretician Chlreee is a Glx and a high-ranking member of the Society of Higher Interstellar Education and Logistical Development (SHIELD), an interplanetary community of scientific researchers and educators operating from the starship Shield Orbiter and in good standing with the Intergalactic Institute of Advanced Learning of the planet Rus. Chlreee is intelligent and well-versed in several fields. left|thumb|Chlreee was visibly angry at Yoof. SHIELD discovered about Earth-born superhuman Firebird (Bonita Juarez) and correctly deduced that her superpowers were related to SHIELD activities. Fearing that Firebird may be a threat or a hindrance to other Earthlings, SHIELD abducted her to perform painful experiments on her body so as to take relevant conclusions. Onboard the Orbiter, Chlreee led the investigation, with fellow SHIELD member Hji operating a machine that gave them information. Chlreee and fellow scientist Cmar Har observed how Firebird resisted her discomfort without screaming; then Firebird spoke out loud in English, and Chlreee immediately asked Hji whether that was a language to be informed of. Afterward, Hji provided a playback of Firebird's recent past; but Chlreee noticed that they had to research into older times. Chlreee discovered that Firebird had joined the Avengers, of which he knew, and concluded that SHIELD had created a "Terran parahuman". Looking at previous events in which Juarez spoke Spanish (with Hji translating), they discovered the meteor-related origin of Firebird's powers, and Chlreee immediately understood that Yrd Base-Level Pupil Yoof had performed an unauthorized experiment, then carelessly disposed of waste elements by throwing those away, and those same residues had empowered Firebird. Chlreee was visibly angry at Yoof. Firebird then released herself and demanded to know what was happening, attacking the scientists (thou the Orbiter's security measures protected them against immediate harm). Chlreee ordered to activate the translator for the two used languages, and stepped forward personally to talk with Firebird, something that Cmar Har appreciated. Chlreee apologized, explained what was happening, and what had happened, and how they only wanted to ensure that Earth remained stable. Firebird was enraged at discovering that young, irresponsible Yoof had accidentally given her powers, and focused an attack and scolding on him; then had a short crisis of faith, as she had believed her powers to have been a sign of God. Chlreee, already impressed at how Firebird had used her powers in the encounter, reassured Firebird, telling her of the specifics of her powers and how useful they were, then returned her to Earth, at which point she had been convinced that God had given her the powers through SHIELD.

Firebird then released herself and demanded to know what was happening, attacking the scientists (thou the Orbiter's security measures protected them against immediate harm). Chlreee ordered to activate the translator for the two used languages, and stepped forward personally to talk with Firebird, something that Cmar Har appreciated. Chlreee apologized, explained what was happening, and what had happened, and how they only wanted to ensure that Earth remained stable. Firebird was enraged at discovering that young, irresponsible Yoof had accidentally given her powers, and focused an attack and scolding on him; then had a short crisis of faith, as she had believed her powers to have been a sign of God. Chlreee, already impressed at how Firebird had used her powers in the encounter, reassured Firebird, telling her of the specifics of her powers and how useful they were, then returned her to Earth, at which point she had been convinced that God had given her the powers through SHIELD.

choke the bear.name: Choke the Bear
choke the bear.origin: Choke the Bear was a mascot for a Houston basketball team. Several years ago, while he was working at a basketball game a meteorite struck the court and hit the mascot in his Choke outfit. The energies mutated the costume granting it powerful abilities. The mascot seemed to lose touch with reality and considered himself to be a "mascot for Houston" and tried to continue doing his job while semi-intentionally destroying parts of the city. After a time, people acclimated to Choke's presence and he grew bored, leading him to move to Mexico. After hearing about the presence of the Scarlet Spider in Houston, Choke decided to return, seeing himself as a hero to smite the villainous Scarlet Spider. When he arrived, he could not find the Scarlet Spider and parts of the city fled in terror. When the Scarlet Spider and teammate Justice arrived, Choke attacked them. Upon hearing Choke's version of events, the Scarlet Spider offered a simple solution; if "Houston isn't big enough for the both of them," he would leave. Choke then turned on Justice as a candidate for a super villain and attacked him. thumb|right Teaming up, Justice and Scarlet Spider were able to defeat choke. They discovered that the man inside the suit had not mutated along with the suit and was a regular-sized man operating the suit. Destroying parts of the suit, they removed him and left him for the police to arrest.

choo choo charley.name: Choo-Choo Charley
choo choo charley.origin: The man known as Choo-Choo Charley was a train robber who was active during the 1940s. By the summer of 1944, he and his men had succeeded in three train robberies. Their next job was to rob a train carrying a load of gold, by first robbing its passengers and then causing the train to wreck itself. Unfortunately for Charley and his gang, the train was carrying the Whizzer while in his civilian alias of Jack Robinson. Quickly changing into the Whizzer, the hero stopped Charley's gang from robbing the passengers and then removed a boulder from the train tracks. Choo-Choo Charley and his gang then attempted to lose the super-speedster by hiding in a local train yard. When this failed to work they rigged the rails to cause two trains to head on a collision course while Charley and his men escaped aboard a third train. However, the Whizzer proved to be too fast and was able to rescue the two endangered locomotives and stop Charley and his gang, turning them over to the authorities. Choo-Choo Charley's subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: Choo-Choo Charley was armed with a pistol.

chow yun woo.origin: After his wife died, Chow Yun Woo asked Wild Tiger Mob for money and in return he would have to make drug deliveries for them. This made him fall into the abyss, making him also a drug addict, and this also affected the physical abuse of his daughter Mai-Yin. Having become friends with Shang-Chi and having told her father's story, Shang-Chi promised himself to help him. Chow continued to serve the Wild Tiger Mob by delivering the drug with his boat even though by now having hit the bottom he was convinced that his end would come soon. When faced with the choice between killing his daughter Mai-Yin or being killed himself on the orders of the boss of the Wild Tiger Mob, he preferred to be killed and was in fact shot by Deng Ling-Xiao, but fortunately he was only wounded . After the defeat of Deng by Shang-Chi and the dismantling of the Mob, Chow reconciled with his little daughter and returned to a more normal and peaceful life.

chris baker.name: Chris Baker
chris baker.origin: Chris Baker was an obsessed fan of a movie star named Millicent Mason. He owned numerous amount of various memorabilia from her appearances in film. While watching one of her movies he was phoned by a journalist named Mario Borgatti who's pursuing a nostalgic story about the star and wishes to use Chris' collection as well as Chris himself in the story. Excited to finally meet the person of his obsession Chris cleaned himself up and awaited their arrival. The two arrived and partook in a photoshoot at Chris's home featuring Chris and Ms. Mason among the collection of her devotion. Chris couldn't get over how young the actress still looked after a thirty year career. During the shoot Chris mentioned that he couldn't find any stills from "The Black Baroness" a film Millicent starred in. Ms. Mason offered to sell any stills she had if she found them at home as her and Mario left from the shoot. Even later that evening Ms. Mason called Chris over to her estate to pick up the stills. Chris arrived at Ms. Mason's estate and knocked on the door. Ms. Mason invited him in and the two chatted while looking around the house until she offered to take him to where the stills were located down into the basement. While walking further down the stairs Ms. Mason informed Chris that she stayed so young looking through the lifeblood of fans just like him. Chris couldn't help but look on in horror as he saw the numerous victims locked in her basement and a hungry mad vampire in the form of his idol lunging towards him, teeth in full display.

The only problem was that Chris Durbin did not remember where it was located as a mishap with dynamite sealed off the mine entrance and scrambled his memory of its location. This, however, did not stop Snake from kidnapping his daughter and holding her ransom for the mine's location. Kid Colt agreed to help Chris Durbin rescue his daughter and rode back into Chaneyville. Riding out on his own, Kid Colt stumbled into the sight of Stan's rifle aim, but Chris Durbin, who was working with Greville told him to stand down. Kid Colt told Greville and Chris Durbin to hide out while he went back to town and rescued Sylvia.

chris mccarthy.name: Chris McCarthy
chris mccarthy.origin: ===Early Life=== Chris McCarthy was a low level S.H.I.E.L.D. agent working in the reconnaissance department on the Helicarrier. When Wolverine was brought in, ===Ant-Man=== Chris and his friend Eric O'Grady, who he grew up with, were tasked with guarding Dr. Henry Pym's lab by a higher ranking agent, Mitch Carson. When Pym went to leave the lab, Eric and Chris panicked and Eric attacked Pym, knocking him unconscious. Inside the lab, they found the most recent version of Ant-Man's Suit, which Chris put on and promptly activated, shrinking down. Thinking him gone, Eric panicked again and ran off. Chris promptly got lost in the Helicarrier, stuck at the 1-Inch size. Eric, meanwhile, took this opportunity to make a pass at Chris' girlfriend Veronica King, which the miniature Chris saw from an air vent. Around this time, a group of Hydra-employed superhumans attacked the Carrier, and Chris and Eric were caught up in the ensuing chaos. Whilst trying to find a safe place to hide, Chris was killed, and Eric took Ant-Man's Suit off his body. Surviving the Helicarrier crash, Eric continued to work for S.H.I.E.L.D., using his evenings to explore the powers of his new suit.
powers: Pym Particles: With the assistance of Pym Particles, Chris had the ability to shrink to the size of an ant, while retaining full size strength, and increase in size and communicate telepathically with insects via a cybernetic helmet.
abilities: Standard S.H.I.E.L.D. weapons training
weapons: Mandible-like tools which swing out like claws
affiliations: Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-616)/Members

chris svoba.name: Chris Svoba
chris svoba.origin: The Sub-Mariner swims up to shore in the town of Waterville and spots a robed gang chasing after a man out of town, telling him that they don't want his kind around. Striking the man with a rock, they knock him into the river, prompting Namor to rescue the man's life. Reviving the man, Namor notices when he drops a silver star and purple heart medals, identifying the man as a war hero. Namor learns the man's name is Joe Svoba, whose family immigrated to America from the Czech Republic. He explains that he served in the American military during the war. He goes on to explain that his father was the skipper for a fishing boat until he was imprisoned for apparently murdering his former employer Mr. George. His father claims he is innocent despite pressure from the townspeople to confess his crime. The pair are suddenly met by Joe's friend Mr. Rogers; Rogers is relieved that the Order of the Blue Flower did not cause him serious harm. Rogers explains to Namor that the Order was recently formed after the murder of George and they have been demanding that the elder Svoba be hung for his crimes without due process. Namor decides to get involved, getting Joe to hide out with Mr. Rogers while he works to clear Joe's fathers name. Meeting with the warden of the state prison, he gets permission to speak with Svoba. Svoba explains that he was employed aboard the Santa Anne for years until one day he and his crew came home to find a note from Mr. George and his partner Larkin informing them that they were all being fired. Demanding answers, Svoba went up to George's office and heard him arguing with Larkin before a number of shots. Barging in, found Larkin dead with the murder weapon on the scene and the killer gone. In the excitement, Svoba made the mistake of picking up the gun just as police entered the room and arrested him for the killing. When he explained that Larkin was responsible for the killing, nobody believed him. Learning that Larkin is responsible for forming the Order of the Blue Flower, and believing Svoba's story, Namor agrees to help clear his name.

chris taylor.name: Chris Taylor
chris taylor.first_appearance: Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers Season 1 1
chris taylor.origin: Chris Taylor is often very cynical, but deep down he has a gentle heart and willing to do the right thing. His father is a lawyer and wanted his son to follow in his footsteps, but Chris has no intention of becoming a lawyer. In fact, he doesn't know what he does want in life, which is part of the reason he is so cynical. Chris was participating in a guided tour by Phil Coulson when Loki and his henchmen attacked the Raft and released multiple supervillains. In the chaos that followed, Chris, along with Jessica and Edward, ran into Akira and Hikaru, who had been ordered by their father, Nozomu Akatsuki, to keep the last biocode installer out of the hands of the villains. When Chris and his new friends saw King Cobra holding Pepper Potts hostage, Akira proposed a rescue mission. Chris at first had no intention of helping out, but changed his mind and actually caused the plan to succeed by dropping a group of containers on top of King Cobra with a forklift truck. When M.O.D.O.K. tried to destroy the installer, the installer gave all five kids, including Chris, a biocode. Chris received the blue biocode. Now that he had a biocode and was thus one of the very few people in the world who could D-smash heroes and villains from their DISKs, Spider-Man tried to convince Chris to join the other four kids and the Avengers. Chris refused however since he didn't consider himself a hero, but he soon got dragged into the adventure anyway when Joel Murphy and Abomination attacked his appartment and took Spider-Man captive. Chris himself escaped thanks to Iron Man, and was thus able to keep Captain America's DISK out of their hands. In Stark Tower, he met up with Akira, Hikaru and Pepper Potts, and reluctantly joined them when they went to confront The Hulk, who was being mind controlled by Diablo and attacking an Air Force Base. When Iron Man and Thor failed to stop the Hulk, Chris finally agreed to become Captain America's partner and D-Smahed the hero to fight Hulk. They succeeded, after which Chris officially joined the others in their quest to fight off Loki and hunt down the DISKs containing the super-villains. Despite being part of the team now, Chris remained cynical and could often be very harsh to his teammates, in particular Ed. He also didn't like the fact that Captain America considered himself to be Chris' mentor rather than a partner, and often compared him to his former partner Bucky. This led to a heated argument between the two when, in a fight with the Wrecking Crew, Chris saved Hikaru from getting crushed under a metal tower, but Captain America scolded him for his recklessness rather than praise his heroic deed. After this, Chris seriously considered leaving the team, and packed his stuff. He returned however when he saw on tv that his friends were fighting a losing battle against Baron Zemo and Predator X, and that Ed had slipped Captain America's DISK into his pocket. With Chris' help, Captain America was able to defeat Zemo, after which he and Chris made amends. Chris was also the first one of the kids who managed to synchronize his biocode with his partner, thus giving Captain America the ability to draw power from him and extend his time limit. When Red Skull started his plan to destroy the world and the Avengers had to split up to take out his 5 bases of operation, Chris and Captain America were tasked with taking out the base guarded by Baron Zemo. They were aided by Deadpool, who gave Chris Iron Fist as a second partner. During the mission, Chris was first confronted with the loss of teammates when the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents that accompanied them where seemingly killed by Green Goblin. Scarred by this loss, Chris was unwilling to risk the life of Hawkeye, who was seemingly held hostage by Baron Zemo, and thus wouldn't D-Smash Captain America to help Deadpool fight Zemo. Only when the whole thing turned out to be a trick did Chris D-Smash Cap. Afterwards, he rescued the injured Deadpool from the self-destructing base, and was the first fo the 5 kids to discover that he could still briefly D-smash a second hero after his first hero's time limit had run out. When all 5 bases were destroyed, Chris also participated in the final fight to defeat Red Skull and his giant robot. While visting a museum at night, Chris became a victim of the vampire Baron Blood (actually an old enemy of his partner, Captain America), and was seemingly turned into a vampire himself. He thus became loyal to Blood and attacked Akira and Iron Man. Iron Man discovered however that Chris's biocode, which had for some time been evolving now, had prevented him from turning into a vampire, and that Chris was instead only believing himself to be a vampire. When Blood send Jessica, Chris, Edward and Hikaru to attack the Avengers base, Blade and Iron Man came up with a plan to save them. By having their Avenger partners use the synchronization between them to power up the biocodes, the biocodes were able to expell Baron Blood's influenc

chrissie cutler.name: Chrissie Cutler
chrissie cutler.origin: Chrissie Cutler and her extended family celebrate with a meal consisting of ancient TV dinners. However, they are unaware that a crack team of soldiers under the employ of the Wright-Anderson Corporation are surrounding the area to reclaim them for the company. In the middle of the celebrations, Bruce Banner has slipped away and stumbled upon the raid and climbs into the vehicle owned by Mohamed Seminsky and demands his assistant Ken provide some answers. At that moment, the Nightmericans find themselves surrounded by soldiers. They are confronted by Mohamed Seminsky who tells the Nightmericans that he only wishes to talk. That's when Bruce arrives with Ken at gunpoint. Simensky welcomes Banner and gets close enough to him to punch him in the face, knowing he had been cured of the Hulk and won't actually shoot anybody. Confirming that Banner won't turn into the Hulk, Simensky congratulates Intergalactic, thanking him for working to lure his "family" back together. Interstellar explains that he did so because plugged into the internet he is flooded with stories of violence and war in the outside world, and that they were created to protect the world from such dangers. thumb|180px|left|Chrissie and Bruce kiss. Soon they are all sequestered and members of Wright-Anderson begins bringing in new equipment, including the graves of dead members of Nightmerica, which Mohamed hopes they can learn from. christi stoger.name: Christi Stoger
christi stoger.origin: Sitting in with staffers Jian Feeta, Christi Stoger and Ethan Crane, Johnny Storm found the latest financial reports from the company dreadfully boring. As Johnny exited the meeting he confided in Jian that the more he learned about the business side of things the more he realized he didn't know. As Jian gave him words of encouragement, Stoger and Crane watched them go on. The pair were scheming against Johnny, putting plans into motion to make him botch the contracts with Suarti International so he got fired and they got a promotion. Johnny, now the Fantastic Four's Chief Financial Officer, was along with Fantastic Four Inc, employees Jian Freeta, Christi Stoger and Ethan Crane as they met with famous fashion designer Jacob Suarti at his penthouse home. Suarti was glad to see Johnny, and began impressing him with his wealthy and bevvy of attractive women. This was all playing into Stoger and Crane's hands who were hoping this business deal became a disaster so they could get Johnny fired and got promoted in his place. Johnny learned that Suarti wanted to purchase the secret to Reed's Unstable Molecules for his next line of fashion. Johnny was initially enticed by the attractive bikini models and quickly snapped out of it. He told Suarti that the Unstable Molecules were a trade secret and not for sale. This was where Stoger and Crane stepped in pointing out that the Fantastic Four licensed out the formula to the Avengers for their uniforms.

christian blake.name: Christian Blake
christian blake.origin: Christian Blake was a detective for the NYPD alongside his partner and childhood friend Carl Hoffman. Both Blake and Hoffman were corrupt, and worked for Wilson Fisk. When Karen Page was arrested for a crime Fisk's men had framed her for, Blake and Hoffman were put in charge of the case. They were forced to release her however, when her lawyers, Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson, forced their hand after no charges had been filed against Page within the twenty-four hours after her arrest. When a member of the Russian mob mentioned Fisk's name during interrogation after his arrest, Blake and Hoffman killed him, and made the murder look like self defense. Matt Murdock was in the precinct and had heard the situation using his heightened senses. Donning his mask, he later attacked and interrogated Blake for the connection between the Russians and Wilson Fisk. The vigilante acquired Blake's cellphone, to which had been sent the addresses of the Russians' locations, and later used it to locate one of their leaders. After a series of explosions caused by Fisk to destroy the Russians' operations, the NYPD cornered the masked vigilante in a warehouse with the Russians' leader Vladimir Ranskahov . As the ESU waited for orders to raid the warehouse, a number of people were being targeted in a bid to frame the vigilante and give the officers a reason to enter. A sniper shot Detective Blake in a calculated move to make him pay for facilitating Rankshkahov's location to the masked vigilante. Blake fell into a coma after being shot, and Fisk, fearing what he might divulge, had Hoffman go to the hospital to finish him off. Blake awoke after being injected with poison, just in time to see the vigilante arrive his assailant, and then block the door. The vigilante told Blake he would die and couldn't do anything about it, but encouraged him to get revenge by telling him all he could about Fisk before he died.

christian poulsen.name: Christian Poulsen
christian poulsen.origin: Tired of being beaten by heroes while working for A.I.M., Stephanie Gerard partnered with former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Christian Poulsen, forming the Exchange, an organization comprised of former members of various groups. One such member named Liam acted independently with a group of Exchange members and fought a gang war at a reception of the wedding of Marine Sergeant Rachel Cole to Daniel Alves, resulting in the death of almost 30 guests and Rachel's new husband. This action put the Exchange on The Punisher's radar, who followed Liam in hopes of finding his bosses. Hoping to stop him, Gerard and Poulsen hired the new Vulture to kill Frank Castle. Their plan failed, but the injuries he sustained kept him out of commission for months. In that space of time, Gerard ordered Poulsen to find a solution to their problem, knowing that his unrequited love for her would make it hard for him to say no. His plan failed as well now that Frank had partnered up with the vengeful Rachel Cole. As Frank and Rachel planned their next move, Gerard began to reciprocate Poulsen's feelings for her. Eventually, Frank and Rachel launched a surprise attack on the Exchange. In the chaos, Rachel choked Gerard to death with a garrote. In a rage over Stephanie's death, Poulsen faced an assault by the police and, at the same time, by the Punisher and Rachel Cole. It was Cole who killed him with three shots to the chest, completing her revenge.

christian sung.name: Christian Sung
christian sung.origin: thumb|left|110px|Human form Christian Sung was born in Duncanville, Texas, of Korean descent. While coursing music studies at Johnson State College, he returned to Texas, terrorizing Austin with his monstrous form. Following several sightings of what people dubbed the "Austin Monster," Christian caught the attention of monster-hunters Amadeus and Maddy Cho. While Maddy was investigating in Austin, Christian began rampaging through the city. After she failed to stop him, Amadeus arrived to assist her in his Hulk form. Christian grew more powerful as he fed on Hulk's emotions, and defeated him, subsequently escaping with an abducted little child. Amadeus and Maddy followed him to the sewers, rescuing the little kid with the help of Black Panther, and later using a protocol meant for the Hulk on Christian himself, which consisted of teleporting him to the Negative Zone.
